ModMetaData.name: CCTO for VPE（CCTO VPE対応）
ModMetaData.author: sucRo0629
ModMetaData.description:
In development: VPE cold-tolerance compatibility using the existing CCTO XML API. Fourteen ordinary VPE 1.6 plants have individual minimum-growth and cold-death or winter-dormancy settings. Six custom-class plants are not yet supported. This source has not been native-game validated or released.
開発中。VPEの通常植物14種にCCTOの最低生育温度・枯死温度・低温休眠を設定するXMLを実装した。独自植物クラス6種は対象外。実機検証と配布は未実施。
